title: Microsoft says it is closing The Garage, which for 17 years gave employees worldwide space and tools for side projects and ran the company's Global Hackathon (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: Microsoft says it is closing The Garage, which for 17 years gave employees worldwide space and tools for side projects and ran the company's Global Hackathon — Microsoft is winding down The Garage as a companywide program, ending a 17-year run for the effort that gave employees space …
